content: Though an action may appear small as a mustard seed, when done in the right season, it looms larger than the world itself.
author: Thiruvalluvar
explanation: A modest act of kindness or assistance provided at the exact moment of another's crisis carries infinite moral weight and eternal gratitude.
practicalInsight: Be alert to colleagues, friends, or family members going through difficulty. Offer an immediate, practical hand without waiting to be asked.
reflectionPrompt: Who in my circle needs a timely word of encouragement or help right now?
